comments.text: 2026-10-19 status: AnthusAI/Anthus-One created and shell with Google sign-in is PR 1 (open; typecheck, tests, build pass). AWS side (Amplify app for 1.anth.us, Cognito pool Google-only, DNS) not started: the Mac Remote Control session went offline 2026-10-19 14:15 UTC and cloud threads cannot message it. Ryan must send the go-ahead message from the Anthus One portal app thread and create a Google OAuth client for 1.anth.us, giving its ID and secret to the Mac session.
